scope: Demonstration of direct text-projection anchoring for RCT, consensus, correction; NOT EvidenceUnit Gold

records.anchor_text: Ninety volunteers who met the eligibility criteria participated in the trial and were randomized at a ratio of 1:1:1 to eTRF, mTRF, and control groups
records.candidate_interpretation: Pilot RCT randomized 90 participants among early-TRF, mid-TRF, and control groups (three-way 1:1:1).

records.anchor_text: The objective of this consensus report is to provide up-to-date knowledge about the epidemiology, pathophysiology, clinical presentation, and recommendations for the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of DKA and HHS in adults
records.candidate_interpretation: Consensus addresses adult hyperglycaemic crises (DKA/HHS), rather than general dietary pattern guidance.

records.anchor_text: In this article, there are amendments to the Methods, Discussion, Author contributions and Competing interests sections.
records.candidate_interpretation: Correction affects multiple sections of the original article, including Methods and Discussion; downstream claims require impact check.
